main_text.p: tùm privatæ cordis & confcientiæ fuæ be-nè cupiunt:ut contemptum nominis divi-ni & fidei violatæ crimen ipsi imprimis sedulò caveamus, juramenta non neces-saria omnino fugiamus, ab aliis indebitè delata constanter recusemus, a nobis de-bitè riteque præstita fideliter expleamus; deinde ut peccandi licentiam & in aliis quoque quantum in nobis est strenuè co-erceamus; Deum denique Opt. Max. assiduè precemur, ut flagello ejus edocti admonitique & sub potenti ejus manu humiliati, ad ipsius misericordiam con-fugiamus, justitiam agnoscamus, gratiam imploremus, in peccatorum nostrorum remissionem, vitæ emendationem, & animarum salutem, per & propter meri-ta domini nostri Iesu Christi. Cui cum Patre & Spiritu Tri-uni Omnipotenti Deo sit regnum, potentia & gloria in Se-cula Seculorum. Amen.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout, including the forms printed as f in "neces-saria" and "sedulò". Hyphenated line-end words keep their printed hyphens. No marginal notes, footnotes, catchword or signature are printed on this page.
